 Rusty’s First Alert 6 Forecast: Warm, muggy & breezy late October day 
 Temperatures jump nearly 20 degrees above average 
 By Rusty Lord Published : Oct. 28, 2026 at 5:28 AM CDT | Updated : Oct. 28, 2026 at 7:45 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OMAHA, Neb. (WOWT) - The weather will change quite a bit over the next 24 to 72 hours starting with a surge in warmer later this afternoon.
 After a few spotty t-showers this morning, we have cleared out some and will keep some sunshine into the afternoon. Highs in the upper 70s are likely with south wind gusts and more humidity.
 Wednesday Afternoon Forecast (First Alert 6) Today (First Alert 6) Today (First Alert 6) Then the focus turns to a cold front dropping in that would try to spark spotty T-showers with downpours and lightning. Those are possible after 5pm through about 11pm tonight, especially east and south of Omaha.
 5pm and after (First Alert 6) Today (First Alert 6) A couple of those could be stronger with hail potential, especially northeast of the metro.
 Tonight (First Alert 6) Then the cooler air pours in tonight and the rest of the night should be quiet. That will lead to a quiet Thursday as well after a little fog fades away.
 3 Day Forecast (First Alert 6) Keep and eye on Friday’s forecast as there still looks to be several rounds of rain and a few storms moving south to north through the area. This is the day with the greatest risk of widespread rain and a few storms. There could be impacts to trunk or treat events and high school football playoff games. That’s when the bulk of this rain in the forecast over the next 3 days will fall.
 Next 72 hours (First Alert 6) Then on Saturday we’ll likely have some morning showers around that linger into the afternoon. I do think the evening hours are trending drier so it’s still looking good for trick-or-treat and the Husker game.
 Saturday (First Alert 6) Saturday (First Alert 6) Sunday is likely to stay pretty cloudy too, further limiting our ability to warm. We’re still tracking widespread rain and storm potential Monday with potential for rain to linger into Tuesday and Wednesday too. That will have some wind with it as well. Colder air should pour in behind that to end next week.
